AcknowledgmentWithinDays.title: Acknowledge Within Days
AcknowledgmentWithinDays.description: Number of days that the supplier site can use to acknowledge the purchasing document.

AgingOnsetPoint.title: Aging Onset Point
AgingOnsetPoint.description: Point where the supplier and the buying organization agree to begin to age consigned material.

AgingOnsetPointCode.title: Aging Onset Point
AgingOnsetPointCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the point where the supplier and the buying organization agree to begin to age consigned material. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type AGING_ONSET_POINT. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

AgingPeriodDays.title: Aging Period Days
AgingPeriodDays.description: Maximum number of days that material can remain on consignment.

AllNewPurchasingDocumentsHoldDate.description: Date when the person who placed a hold on new purchasing documents for the supplier site.

AllowSubstituteReceipts.title: Allow Substitute Receipts
AllowSubstituteReceipts.description: Indicates whether the supplier site allows a substitute receipt. Values include Y for Yes or N for No.

AllowSubstituteReceiptsCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies whether the supplier site allows a substitute receipt. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type YES_NO. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

AllowUnorderedReceiptsFlag.title: Allow unordered receipts
AllowUnorderedReceiptsFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the supplier site can receive a receipt that doesn't include a purchase order. If false, then the supplier site requires a purchase order. The default value is false.

AlternatePaySite.title: Alternate Pay Site
AlternatePaySite.description: Name of the alternate pay site.

AlternatePaySiteId.title: Alternate Pay Site
AlternatePaySiteId.description: Value that uniquely identifies the alternate pay site.

AlternateSiteName.title: Alternate Site Name
AlternateSiteName.description: Alternate name of the supplier site.

AlwaysTakeDiscount.title: Always Take Discount
AlwaysTakeDiscount.description: Determines whether to apply a discount on the payment. Contains one of the following values: Y, apply discount. N, don't apply discount. D, use the default from the payables options to determine whether to apply the discount.

AlwaysTakeDiscountCode.description: Abbreviation that determines whether to apply a discount on the payment. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type POZ_PAYABLES_OPTIONS. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

AmountTolerances.title: Amount Tolerances
AmountTolerances.description: Tolerance to apply to the amount when creating an invoice for the supplier site.

AmountTolerancesId.title: Amount Tolerances
AmountTolerancesId.description: Value that uniquely identifies the tolerance to apply to the quantity when creating an invoice for the supplier site.

B2BCommunicationMethod.title: Enable B2B Messaging
B2BCommunicationMethod.description: Attribute renamed as Enable B2B Messaging. Indicates if the application should communicate the documents during a business-to-business procurement transaction through common messaging framework for the supplier site.

B2BCommunicationMethodCode.title: Enable B2B Messaging
B2BCommunicationMethodCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies whether the communication of the documents during a business-to-business procurement transaction is enabled for the supplier site. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type ORA_POZ_B2B_COMM_METHOD. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

B2BSupplierSiteCode.title: B2B Supplier Site Code
B2BSupplierSiteCode.description: Abbreviation that uniquely identifies a specific supplier site, which is used in the punchout for Self Service Procurement.

BankChargeDeductionType.title: Bank Charge Deduction Type
BankChargeDeductionType.description: Determines how to deduct bank charges when paying the invoice. Contains one of the following values: S, use the standard deduction. D, use the default value from payables options. N, use the negotiated deduction. X, don't use any deduction.

BankChargeDeductionTypeCode.title: Bank Charge Deduction Type
BankChargeDeductionTypeCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies whether and how to deduct bank charges when paying the invoice. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type BANK_CHARGE_DEDUCTION_TYPE. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Payables Lookups task.

BuyerManagedTransportation.title: Buyer Managed Transportation
BuyerManagedTransportation.description: Indicates whether the buyer manages transportation. Values include Y for Yes, N for No, or empty.

BuyerManagedTransportationCode.title: Buyer Managed Transportation
BuyerManagedTransportationCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies whether the buyer manages transportation. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type YES_NO. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

Carrier.title: Carrier
Carrier.description: Carrier that the supplier uses for shipping.

CarrierId.title: Carrier
CarrierId.description: Value that uniquely identifies the carrier that the supplier site uses for shipping.

CommunicationMethod.title: Communication Method
CommunicationMethod.description: Preferred method of communication for the supplier site. Values include NONE, FAX, EMAIL, or PRINT.

CommunicationMethodCode.title: Communication Method
CommunicationMethodCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the preferred method of communication for the supplier site. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type DOCUMENT_COMMUNICATION_METHOD. You can't modify this lookup.

ConsumptionAdviceFrequency.title: Consumption Advice Frequency
ConsumptionAdviceFrequency.description: How frequently the Create Consumption Advice application runs for consumption transactions. This application runs for consigned inventory that the customer purchased under one agreement.

ConsumptionAdviceFrequencyCode.title: Consumption Advice Frequency
ConsumptionAdviceFrequencyCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies how frequently the Create Consumption Advice application runs for consumption transactions. The application runs for consigned inventory that the customer purchased under one agreement. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type CONSUMPTION_ADVICE_FREQUENCY. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

ConsumptionAdviceSummary.title: Consumption Advice Summary
ConsumptionAdviceSummary.description: Level of detail to use when creating the consumption advice.

ConsumptionAdviceSummaryCode.title: Consumption Advice Summary
ConsumptionAdviceSummaryCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the level of detail to use when creating the consumption advice. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type CONSUMPTION_ADVICE_SUMMARY. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

CountryOfOrigin.title: Country of Origin
CountryOfOrigin.description: Country of origin that the supplier site uses to calculate freight.

CountryOfOriginCode.title: Country of Origin
CountryOfOriginCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the country of origin that the supplier site uses to calculate freight.

CreateDebitMemoFromReturnFlag.title: Create debit memo from return
CreateDebitMemoFromReturnFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the supplier site creates a debit memo from the return transaction. If false, then the supplier site doesn't create this memo. The default value is false.

CreateInterestInvoices.title: Create Interest Invoices
CreateInterestInvoices.description: Determines whether to create an interest invoice. Contains one of the following values: Y, create an invoice. N, don't create an invoice. D, use the default from the payables options to determine whether to create an invoice.

CreateInterestInvoicesCode.description: Abbreviation that determines whether to create an interest invoice. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type POZ_PAYABLES_OPTIONS. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

CustomerNumber.title: Customer Number
CustomerNumber.description: Number that identifies the site of the buying organization.

EarlyReceiptToleranceInDays.title: Early Receipt Tolerance in Days
EarlyReceiptToleranceInDays.description: Number of days that the receiving location can receive receipts before the expected receipt date.

Email.title: Email
Email.description: Email that the communication method uses.

ExcludeFreightFromDiscount.title: Exclude Freight from Discount
ExcludeFreightFromDiscount.description: Determines whether to exclude freight when calculating discount. Contains one of the following values: Y, exclude freight. N, include freight. D, use the default from the payables options to determine whether to exclude freight.

ExcludeFreightFromDiscountCode.description: Abbreviation that determines whether to exclude freight when calculating discount. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type POZ_PAYABLES_OPTIONS. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

ExcludeTaxFromDiscount.title: Exclude Tax from Discount
ExcludeTaxFromDiscount.description: Determines whether to exclude tax when calculating the discount. Contains one of the following values: Y, exclude tax. N, include tax. D, use the default from the payables options to determine whether to exclude tax.

ExcludeTaxFromDiscountCode.description: Abbreviation that determines whether to exclude tax when calculating the discount. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type POZ_PAYABLES_OPTIONS. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

FOB.title: FOB
FOB.description: Free on Board (FOB) value for the supplier site.

FOBCode.title: FOB
FOBCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the Free On Board value for the supplier site. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type FOB. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage FOB Lookup task.

FaxAreaCode.title: Fax Area Code
FaxAreaCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the area for the fax that the communication method uses at the supplier site.

FaxCountryCode.title: Fax Country Code
FaxCountryCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the country for the fax that the communication method uses at the supplier site.

FreightTerms.title: Freight Terms
FreightTerms.description: Terms for shipping from the supplier site.

FreightTermsCode.title: Freight Terms
FreightTermsCode.description: Agreement that describes terms for shipping from the supplier site. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type FREIGHT TERMS. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Freight Terms Lookup task.

GaplessInvoiceNumberingFlag.title: Gapless invoice numbering
GaplessInvoiceNumberingFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the supplier site numbers their invoices so they're consecutive and don't include gaps. If false, then the supplier site doesn't use this numbering. The default value is false.

HoldAllInvoicesFlag.title: Hold All Invoices
HoldAllInvoicesFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the supplier site puts a hold on all invoices. If false, then the site does put them on hold. The default value is false.

HoldAllNewPurchasingDocumentsFlag.title: Hold all new purchasing documents
HoldAllNewPurchasingDocumentsFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then place all new purchasing documents on hold. If false, then don't place them on hold. The default value is false.

HoldUnmatchedInvoices.title: Hold Unmatched Invoices
HoldUnmatchedInvoices.description: Determines whether to place a hold on each invoice that doesn't contain a relationship with a purchase order, receipt, or consumption advice. Values include Y for Yes, N for No, or empty.

HoldUnmatchedInvoicesCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies whether to place a hold on each invoice that doesn't contain a relationship with a purchase order, receipt, or consumption advice. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type POZ_PAYABLES_OPTIONS. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

HoldUnvalidatedInvoicesFlag.title: Hold Unvalidated Invoices
HoldUnvalidatedInvoicesFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the supplier site places all invoices that it can't validate on hold. If false, then the supplier site doesn't put them hold. The default value is false.

InactiveDate.title: Inactive Date
InactiveDate.description: Date when the supplier site is no longer active.

IncomeTaxReportingSiteFlag.title: Income tax reporting site
IncomeTaxReportingSiteFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the supplier site is a tax reporting site. If false, then supplier site isn't a tax reporting site. The default value is false.

InvoiceAmountLimit.title: Invoice Amount Limit
InvoiceAmountLimit.description: Indicates the maximum amount for which an invoice can be created beyond which an invoice will go on hold.

InvoiceChannel.title: Invoice Channel
InvoiceChannel.description: Channel that the supplier uses to provide invoices for the supplier site.

InvoiceChannelCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the channel that the supplier uses to provide invoices for the supplier site. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type ORA_POZ_INVOICE_CHANNEL. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

InvoiceCurrencyCode.title: Invoice Currency
InvoiceCurrencyCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the currency that the invoice uses.

InvoiceMatchOption.title: Invoice Match Option
InvoiceMatchOption.description: Indicates whether to create a relationship between the invoice and a purchase order, receipt, or consumption advice.

InvoiceMatchOptionCode.title: Invoice Match Option
InvoiceMatchOptionCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies whether to create a relationship between the invoice and a purchase order, receipt, or consumption advice. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type INVOICE_MATCH_OPTION. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Payables Lookups task.

InvoiceSummaryLevel.title: Invoice Summary Level
InvoiceSummaryLevel.description: Determines how to group and summarize invoices for the supplier site.

InvoiceSummaryLevelCode.title: Invoice Summary Level
InvoiceSummaryLevelCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies how to group and summarize invoices for the supplier site. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type POZ_ERS_INVOICE_SUMMARY. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

LateReceiptToleranceInDays.title: Late Receipt Tolerance in Days
LateReceiptToleranceInDays.description: Number of days that the receiving location can receive receipts after the expected receipt date.

MatchApprovalLevel.title: Match Approval Level
MatchApprovalLevel.description: Approval level to use when creating a relationship between the invoice and a purchase order, receipt, or consumption advice.

MatchApprovalLevelCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the approval level to use when creating a relationship between the invoice and a purchase order, receipt, or consumption advice. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type INVOICE_MATCH. You can't modify this lookup.

ModeOfTransport.title: Mode of Transport
ModeOfTransport.description: Mode of transport that the supplier site uses for shipping.

ModeOfTransportCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the mode of transport that the supplier site uses for shipping. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type WSH_MODE_OF_TRANSPORT. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

OverReceiptAction.title: Overreceipt Action
OverReceiptAction.description: Action to take when the receiving location receives quantity that exceeds the tolerance.

OverReceiptActionCode.title: Overreceipt Action
OverReceiptActionCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the action to take when the receiving location receives quantity that exceeds the tolerance. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type RCV_RECEIVING_OPTION. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

OverReceiptTolerance.title: Overreceipt Tolerance
OverReceiptTolerance.description: Tolerance to use when the receiving location receives more than the requested quantity.

OverrideB2BCommunicationforSpecialHandli.title: Override B2B communication for special handling orders
OverrideB2BCommunicationforSpecialHandli.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, the configured B2B communication is overridden for the supplier site's special handling purchase orders. If false, then the B2B configuration for the supplier site is honored. The default value is true.

PayDateBasis.title: Pay Date Basis
PayDateBasis.description: Date that the application scheduled to run payment for the invoice.

PayDateBasisCode.title: Pay Date Basis
PayDateBasisCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the date the application scheduled to run payment for the invoice. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type POZ_PAY_DATE_BASIS. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Payables Lookups task.

PayGroup.title: Pay Group
PayGroup.description: Withholding tax group for the site assignment.

PayGroupCode.title: Pay Group
PayGroupCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the withholding tax group for the site assignment. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type PAY_GROUP. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Payables Lookups task.

PayOnReceiptFlag.title: Pay on receipt
PayOnReceiptFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the supplier site allows pay on receipt. If false, then the supplier site doesn't allow pay on receipt. The default value is false.

PayOnUseFlag.title: Pay on use
PayOnUseFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the supplier site allows pay on use. If false, then the supplier site doesn't allow pay on use. The default value is false.

PaymentCurrency.title: Payment Currency
PaymentCurrency.description: Currency that the payment uses to pay the invoice.

PaymentCurrencyCode.title: Payment Currency
PaymentCurrencyCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the currency that the payment uses to pay the invoice.

PaymentHoldDate.title: Payment Hold Date
PaymentHoldDate.description: Date when the application places payments to the supplier site on hold.

PaymentHoldReason.title: Payment Hold Reason
PaymentHoldReason.description: Reason why the application placed the invoices that it created for the supplier site on hold.

PaymentPriority.title: Payment Priority
PaymentPriority.description: Priority to assign to an invoice during payment.

PaymentTerms.title: Payment Terms
PaymentTerms.description: Terms of payment for the supplier site.

PaymentTermsDateBasis.title: Terms Date Basis
PaymentTermsDateBasis.description: Date when the application scheduled to run payment terms for the invoice.

PaymentTermsDateBasisCode.title: Terms Date Basis
PaymentTermsDateBasisCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the date the application scheduled to run payment terms for the invoice. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type TERMS_DATE_BASIS. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Payables Lookups task.

PaymentTermsId.title: Payment Terms
PaymentTermsId.description: Value that uniquely identifies each payment term for the supplier site.

ProcurementBU.title: Procurement BU
ProcurementBU.description: Procurement business unit where the supplier site resides.

ProcurementBUId.title: Procurement BU
ProcurementBUId.description: Value that uniquely identifies the procurement business unit where the supplier site resides.

PurchasingHoldReason.title: Hold Reason
PurchasingHoldReason.description: Reason why the person who placed the hold on purchasing for the supplier site.

QuantityTolerances.title: Quantity Tolerances
QuantityTolerances.description: Tolerance to apply to the quantity when creating an invoice for the supplier site.

QuantityTolerancesId.title: Quantity Tolerances
QuantityTolerancesId.description: Value that uniquely identifies the tolerance to apply to quantity when creating an invoice for the supplier site.

ReceiptDateException.title: Receipt Date Exception
ReceiptDateException.description: Action to take when the supplier site receives an item before Early Receipt Tolerance in Days or after Late Receipt Tolerance in Days.

ReceiptDateExceptionCode.title: Receipt Date Exception
ReceiptDateExceptionCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the action to taken when the supplier site receives an item before Early Receipt Tolerance in Days or after Late Receipt Tolerance in Days. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type RCV_RECEIVING_OPTION. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

ReceiptRouting.title: Receipt Routing
ReceiptRouting.description: Indicates how to route each receipt for the supplier site.

ReceiptRoutingId.title: Receipt Routing
ReceiptRoutingId.description: Value that uniquely identifies how to route each receipt for the supplier site.

RequiredAcknowledgment.title: Required Acknowledgment
RequiredAcknowledgment.description: Type of acknowledgment. This attribute is used when the purchasing document that the application created for the supplier site requires an acknowledgment. Valid values include Document, Document and Schedule, and None.

RequiredAcknowledgmentCode.title: Required Acknowledgment
RequiredAcknowledgmentCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the acknowledgment. This attribute is used when the purchasing document that the application created for the supplier site requires an acknowledgment. Valid values include D, Y, and N.

SellingCompanyIdentifier.title: Selling Company Identifier
SellingCompanyIdentifier.description: Value that uniquely identifies the selling company. This attribute is required when the supplier site uses gapless invoice numbering.

ServiceLevel.title: Service Level
ServiceLevel.description: Service level that the supplier site uses for shipping.

ServiceLevelCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the service levels that the supplier site uses for shipping. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type WSH_SERVICE_LEVELS. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

ShipToException.title: Ship-to Exception Action
ShipToException.description: Action to take when the receiving location is different from the ship-to location.

ShipToExceptionCode.title: Ship-to Exception Action
ShipToExceptionCode.description: Abbreviation that identifies the action to take when the receiving location is different from the ship-to location. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup type RCV_RECEIVING_OPTION. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Standard Lookups task.

SitePurposePayFlag.title: Pay
SitePurposePayFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then a pay purpose exists for the supplier site. If false, then pay purpose doesn't exist. The default value is false.

SitePurposePrimaryPayFlag.title: Primary pay
SitePurposePrimaryPayFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then primary pay purpose exists for the supplier site. If false, then primary pay purpose doesn't exist. The default value is false.

SitePurposeProcurementCardFlag.title: Procurement card
SitePurposeProcurementCardFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then a procurement card exists for the supplier site. If false, then procurement card doesn't exist. The default value is false.

SitePurposePurchasingFlag.title: Purchasing
SitePurposePurchasingFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then a purchasing purpose exists for the supplier site. If false, then purpose doesn't exist. The default value is false.

SitePurposeSourcingOnlyFlag.title: Sourcing only
SitePurposeSourcingOnlyFlag.description: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the supplier has sourcing only purpose. If false, then the supplier site doesn't have sourcing only purpose. The default value is false.

SupplierAddressId.description: Value that uniquely identifies the supplier address.

SupplierSiteId.title: Site
SupplierSiteId.description: Value that uniquely identifies the supplier site.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: The attachments resource is used to view, create, and update attachments.

thirdPartyPaymentRelationships.title: Third-Party Payment Relationships
thirdPartyPaymentRelationships.description: Supplier site third-party relationships are retrieved.
